description: Archivo 2009-2019: Indicadores Sectoriales de Transporte y Logística is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Industria, Comercio y de la Pequeña y Mediana Empresa. Resumen de los principales indicadores del sector de Transporte y Logística, costos principales insumos de las operaciones logísticas. Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Industria, Comercio y de la Pequeña y Mediana Empresa. Its tags are Carga, Costos, Logística, Precios, Transporte. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
